title: A Visitor From Another Star Carries Unusual Heavy Methane
paragraphs: A comet is visiting our solar system. It comes from another star. Its name is 3I/ATLAS.
Scientists used the Webb space telescope. They looked at gas around the comet. The gas is called methane.
The methane has a lot of heavy hydrogen. This is very unusual. It may mean the comet was made in a very cold place.

questions.q: Where does the comet come from?
What may the heavy hydrogen mean?
questions.a: The comet was made in a very cold place.
